messages:
Tara Lin: Quick regroup on tri-mode landing copy. Goal: one short hero line per mode, a micro-benchmark badge option for Hosted, two CTA variants each, and a clear inbound-routing snippet. Freeze end of day Wednesday.
Ben Ortiz: I can pull Dedicated throughput numbers from infra and drop a one-line stat. Also want an enterprise microline for Private about keys/KMS.
Sam - copy: Ill draft three super-short hero options for each mode: developer-first, performance-first, and trust-first. Will keep Hosted language plain English and avoid heavy on numbers in hero.
Riley (growth): Routing rules sketch below  will convert to YAML once copy is final. We need immediate AE for any compliance keyword or >$10K ARR signals. Otherwise map Hosted -> self-serve; Dedicated -> AE; Private -> AE + security intro.
Iris (analytics): Suggest we include a performance-badge A/B test on Hosted hero: variant A shows badge "sub-200ms 99th" + CTA "See benchmarks"; variant B is control with CTA "Get started". Measure signups and demo requests.
Sam - copy: Hosted hero candidates:
- "Hosted API: production performance, zero infra ops."
- "Start building with a high-performance hosted API."
- "Low-latency inference you can depend on."
Hosted badge microcopy (optional): "Sub-200ms 99th on common production workloads"
Ben Ortiz: Dedicated hero candidates:
- "Dedicated GPU pools for predictable throughput and cost."
- "Reserve capacity. Control latency."
Dedicated microline: "SLA-backed uptime and configurable autoscale."
Sam - copy: Private hero candidates:
- "Private deployments: VPC & on-prem with enterprise controls."
- "Customer-managed network and keys, audit-ready."
Sam - copy: CTA pairs (A/B):
- Hosted: ["Get started (free)", "See performance tests"]
- Dedicated: ["Request capacity review", "Get pricing"]
- Private: ["Talk to sales", "Request security brief"]
Riley (growth): Proposed UTM scheme: ?utm_source=landing&utm_campaign=tri_mode_copytest&utm_content=variantA. We'll append utm_content to route leads.
Riley (growth): Routing pseudo-code (will make YAML):
```
if text contains /HIPAA|SOC2|PCI|compliance/i -> route: AE + security
else if company_mrr_estimate > 10000 or employee_count > 200 -> route: AE
else if interest_tags contains ("embeddings","prototype","quick-test") -> route: self-serve
else -> route: AE-review (hold for 24h then auto-assign)
```
Iris (analytics): We'll wire event names: landing_cta_click, landing_badge_view. Add property variant=badge|control. Funnel: click -> signup -> activation.
Ben Ortiz: Provisional Dedicated stat from infra: "~170k tokens/sec per cluster (depends on model & seq len)". Will confirm exact number by tomorrow. Use as micro-callout: "~170k tokens/sec cluster (typical)."
Sam - copy: Webinar tie-in for Hosted: short blurb: "Live demo: batching & caching to cut inference cost. 30-min walkthrough + Q&A." CTA: "Register for webinar" with calendar link.
Tara Lin: Design ask: provide hero copy + two CTA texts per mode by EOD so they can make A/B variants. Also give copy for the badge tooltip copy (one sentence).
Sam - copy: Badge tooltip draft: "Measured on representative production workloads; results vary by model and request pattern. See full bench lab."
deploy-bot: Reminder: copy freeze window opens 1768972800 (Thu 00:00 UTC).
Riley (growth): I'll convert the routing pseudo-code to YAML after copy freeze and include UTM->SFDC mapping.
Tara Lin: Thanks team. Sam drop the three hero options + CTAs here in the next 3 hours and well pick winners for the A/B test. :sparkles:
